verdict.rationale: Firebase's own Cloud Functions docs state that functions can run in response to Cloud Scheduler jobs, so recurring backend jobs are a documented capability. The evidence is a single sentence, though, and the scheduling itself relies on Google Cloud Scheduler. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule definition (cron syntax, time zones, retries), multi-step workflow orchestration, AI/agent-driven scheduling (e.g. via the MCP server), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
